blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Quantitative analysis of environmental phenomena increasingly relies on image-based measurements. In volcanology, the geometric characterization of volcanic plumes and clouds from RGB images remains hindered by the scarcity of dedicated segmentation solutions and partially handcrafted annotations remain widely prevalent. We present GuidedSAM-Plume, an open-source expert-guided framework tailored for the interactive segmentation of volcanic plumes and clouds. It leverages the zero-shot, spatial prompt-based capabilities of SAM2. The framework was thoroughly validated on a challenging dataset through dedicated segmentation metrics and field-relevant volcanological descriptors. From minimal user inputs, it is able to significantly increase performance compared to fully automatic dedicated solutions while preserving the reliability of derived volcanological parameters. The absence of retraining requirements lowers adoption barriers within the volcanological community, and the framework's demonstrated suitability for complex, diffuse plume-shaped phenomena extends its applicability to broader environmental science domains. The re-annotated dataset, produced under the guidance of expert volcanologists within the proposed framework, ultimately yields a more standardized release. The framework and accompanying dataset are made available at https://github.com/tad-damo/GuidedSAM-Plume.
blocks.zh: 对环境现象的定量分析越来越依赖于基于图像的测量. 在火山学中,来自RGB图像的火山羽和云的几何特征因专用分解溶液的缺乏而仍然受到阻碍,而部分手工制作的说明仍然普遍存在. 我们介绍GuidedSAM-Plume,这是专门为火山羽流和云层交互分化设计的开源专家指导框架。 它利用了SAM2的零发速成能力. 该框架通过专用分块测量仪和与实地有关的火山描述仪,在一个具有挑战性的数据集上得到了彻底验证。 与全自动专用解决方案相比,它从最低限度的用户输入可以大大提高性能,同时保持了所衍生出火山参数的可靠性. 缺乏再培训要求降低了火山学界内的收养障碍,而且该框架已证明适合复杂而分散的羽毛状现象,从而将其适用于更广泛的环境科学领域。 重新附加说明的数据集在拟议框架内由火山学家专家指导制作,最终使数据发布更加标准化。 框架和配套数据集见https://github.com/tad-damo/GuidedSAM-Plume。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Across scientific domains, image segmentation is a core task enabling downstream analysis of natural phenomena [ 33 ] . In fields from biomedical imaging [ 27 ] to environmental monitoring [ 35 ] , binary masks are a critical prerequisite for quantitative characterization of observed objects. This work aims at leveraging recent computer vision advances to benefit environmental sciences, with a concrete application to volcanology. Explosive volcanic eruptions produce ash plumes and clouds, influencing atmospheric processes and impacting environments from local to global scales.
Segmentation is of crucial importance in that field as delineating plumes allows for the quantitative analysis and retrieval of real-world physical parameters, such as plume morphology, spatial extent, and temporal dynamics [ 30 ] . However, automated plume segmentation in visible imagery remains limited due to scarce contributions [ 35 , 11 ] and deep learning solutions have not yet reached widespread adoption in this domain. Traditional threshold-based algorithms are sensitive to contrast conditions, leading many volcanologists to rely on partly handcrafted masks. In these conditions, obtaining segmentation masks not only requires considerable annotation effort but also leads to inconsistencies across datasets produced by different operators, due to a lack of methodological standardization. This introduces subjective biases when comparing studies [ 2 ] .
Meanwhile, research in computer vision has demonstrated strong capabilities for the segmentation task [ 32 ] and has progressed toward foundation models [ 4 ] , achieving high generalization performance across a wide range of applications, as exemplified by the Segment Anything Model (SAM) [ 17 ] . We were led by the hypothesis that, despite the inherent complexity of volcanic plumes, such advances should render their analysis more tractable even in data-limited settings.
blocks.zh:
在整个科学领域,图像分割是一项核心任务,有助于对自然现象进行下游分析[33]。 在从生物医学成像[27]到环境监测[35]的领域中,二进制面具是观测物体定量定性的关键前提. 这项工作旨在利用最近的计算机远景发展,使环境科学受益,具体应用于火山学。 爆炸性火山爆发产生灰羽和云,影响大气过程,影响从地方到全球的环境。
分化在该领域至关重要,因为分解羽流有助于对现实世界的物理参数进行定量分析和检索,如羽流形态、空间范围以及时间动态[30]。 然而,由于贡献很少[35,11],可见图像中的自动羽流分解仍然有限,而深层学习解决方案尚未在这一领域得到广泛采用。 传统的基于阈值的算法对对比条件很敏感,导致许多火山学家依赖部分手工制作的口罩. 在这些情况下,获得分解口罩不仅需要作出相当的注解努力,而且由于缺乏方法标准化,导致不同操作人员生产的数据集不一致。 这在比较研究时引入了主观偏见[2].
同时,对计算机视觉的研究显示,分解任务[32]具有强大能力,并朝着基础模型[4]迈进,在广泛的应用中实现了高通化性能,例如,分解任意模式[17]。 我们所持的假设是,尽管火山羽流固有的复杂性,但这种进步应使其分析更便于使用,即使在数据有限的环境中也是如此。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en:
1. Efficient interactive segmentation framework for volcanic plumes and clouds We introduce GuidedSAM-Plume , an open-source interactive segmentation framework designed through quantitative analysis and close collaboration with volcanologists to address actual operational needs. It enables reliable and reproducible plume delineation in both images and video sequences, maintaining refinement control while substantially reducing annotation costs, by leveraging the zero-shot capabilities of SAM2 [ 26 ] within an expert-in-the-loop strategy. The eliminated requirement for extensive retraining should lower adoption barriers for volcanology and broader environmental monitoring applications facing similar challenges. 2. Standardized dataset A novel dataset is released comprising 47 observational sequences totaling 759 annotated frames drawn from multiple eruptive events, representative of data typically employed in volcanological studies.
Initially to evaluate the framework, the dataset was re-annotated under the supervision of expert volcanologists following the structured workflow. The resulting segmentation masks demonstrated adequate quality for downstream analysis and being inherently more standardized than those produced by multiple independent annotators, both annotation versions have been made publicly available. 3. Validation for real-world science The effectiveness of the framework is demonstrated through segmentation quality assessment against the manually annotated ground truth of the aforementioned dataset. Beyond standard metrics, outputs are further validated via application-driven evaluation based on the extraction of geometric and physical plume descriptors, supporting both the validity of the proposed framework and the relevance of the standardized dataset for real-world volcanological applications.
blocks.zh:
一、导 言 火山羽流和云层的有效交互分块框架 我们引入了GuidedSAM-Plume,这是一个开源交互式分块框架,通过定量分析和与火山学家的密切合作来设计,以满足实际的业务需要。 它通过利用SAM2[26]在专家即时战略中的零射能力,在图像和视频序列中进行可靠和可复制的羽流划界,保持精密控制,同时大幅度减少注释成本。 取消对广泛再培训的要求应减少火山学的采纳障碍和面临类似挑战的更广泛的环境监测应用。 2. 标准化数据集 发布的新数据集包括47个观测序列,共计759个附加说明的从多个爆发事件提取的帧,代表了火山学研究中通常使用的数据。
最初是为了评价框架,在火山专家的监督下,按照结构化的工作流程重新对数据集作了说明。 由此产生的分解口罩表明,下游分析的质量是足够的,而且与多个独立注释员制作的口罩相比,具有内在的更标准化,两种注释版本都已公开。 3. 验证现实世界科学 参照上述数据集的人工附加说明的地面真实性进行分解质量评估,证明了框架的有效性。 除了标准衡量标准外,还根据几何和物理羽流描述词的提取,通过应用驱动的评价进一步验证产出,支持拟议框架的有效性和标准化数据集对现实世界火山学应用的相关性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Volcanology-dedicated solutions
blocks.zh: 2.1 火山学专用解决方案

blocks.en:
While visible-wavelength cameras are widely deployed on volcanoes for
monitoring purposes [ 1 , 30 ] , dedicated
image segmentation solutions for the scientific analysis of volcanic
eruptions remain limited. Early semi-automatic approaches, such as the
Plume Ascent Tracker [ 34 ] and PlumeTraP [ 30 ] require substantial manual effort and are
strongly dependent on operator input for segmentation. Initial deep
learning approaches remained volcano-specific, targeting individual
sites such as Mount Etna (Italy) [ 12 ] or Sabancaya (Peru) [ 6 ] . Wilkes et al. [ 35 ] attempted to
address this limitation with three UNet- [ 27 ] or
FPN-based [ 18 ] architectures designed to generalize
across multiple volcanoes without retraining; however, the limited
size of their training and validation datasets suggests that reported
performance may overestimate real-world applicability. More recently,
VigiaPlume-Net [ 11 ] leverages DINOv2 [ 22 ] for fine-grained six-category
segmentation. However, the highly variable imaging conditions and dynamic irregular plume structures limit fully automated approaches for static image segmentation and should motivate methods exploiting video sequences for better spatiotemporal characterization.
Furthermore, while other scientific domains benefit from dedicated segmentation platforms, for instance AnnotatorJ [ 14 ] within the widely adopted ImageJ ecosystem [ 28 ] for microscopy, no comparable solution currently exists for volcanic plume analysis.

blocks.en: 2.2 Interactive Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.2 互动分部

blocks.en: During the last decade, deep learning has become the dominant paradigm for image segmentation, progressing from convolutional [ 20 , 7 ] to transformer-based architectures [ 9 , 8 ] with remarkable performance gains across wide range of applications. Fully-automated approaches require large annotated datasets, costly training, and offer limited output control. Interactive segmentation has emerged as a compelling alternative [ 15 , 31 , 36 ] , offering a better balance between annotation effort and output quality through iterative refinement, as demonstrated by frameworks such as Ilastik [ 3 ] . Interactive segmentation offers a favorable balance between annotation effort and output quality through iterative refinement, making it particularly attractive for complex, expert-guided tasks [ 2 ] . The more recent emergence of foundation models further transformed the field by introducing large-scale models designed to generalize across tasks and domains [ 9 , 25 , 4 ] . In this context, the Segment Anything Model (SAM) represents a major step toward universal image segmentation. It enables zero-shot segmentation without task-specific training, relying on flexible user prompts such as bounding boxes, points, or coarse masks [ 17 ] . Its architecture combines a vision transformer-based image encoder, a prompt encoder, and an efficient mask decoder. SAM has been widely adopted and has inspired numerous derivatives [ 23 , 37 , 16 , 38 ] . Its successor, SAM2, further improves spatial coherence and additionally enables segmentation videos thank the addition of a memory bank and memory attention module [ 26 ] . More recently, SAM3 [ 5 ] goes beyond simple spatial prompting by introducing textual referring segmentation and exemplar prompts.
blocks.zh: 在过去十年中,深入学习已经成为图像分割的主导范式,从革命[20,7]发展到变压器结构[9,8],在广泛的应用中取得了显著的性能成就. 完全自动化的方法需要大量的附加说明的数据集、昂贵的培训以及有限的产出控制。 互动分割已经成为一种令人信服的选择[15、31、36],通过迭代完善在注释努力和产出质量之间提供了更好的平衡,伊拉斯蒂克等框架就证明了这一点。 互动分解通过迭代完善在注释努力和产出质量之间提供了有利的平衡,使其对复杂、专家指导的任务特别有吸引力[2]。 最近的基础模型的出现进一步改变了这个领域,引进了大规模模型,旨在概括跨任务和领域[9、25、4]。 在这方面,任何部分模型(SAM)是朝着普遍图像分割迈出的重要一步。 它可以在不经过任务特定训练的情况下进行零射片分割,依靠灵活的用户提示,如边框,点,或粗口罩[17]. 它的架构结合了基于视觉变压器的图像编码器,即时编码器,以及高效的面具解码器. SAM被广泛采用,并激励了众多衍生作品[23,37,16,38]. 其继任者SAM2进一步改善了空间一致性,并额外使分片视频得以实现,感谢增加了一个记忆库和记忆关注模块[26]. 最近,SAM3[5]通过引入文本引用分解和示例提示,超越了简单的空间提示.

blocks.en: 3 GuidedSAM-Plume
blocks.zh: 3 向导SAM-Plume

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the GuidedSAM-Plume framework and its workflow. For still images, segmentation is initialized with a bounding box (top left) and iteratively refined using foreground and background point prompts (top right). For video sequences, the process is initialized on a representative keyframe near the middle of the sequence (bottom left), followed by temporal tracking and refinement through additional keyframes (bottom right).
blocks.zh: 图1:指南SAM-Plume框架及其工作流程概览。 对于静态图像,用一个边框(左上)初始化分割,并使用前景和背景点提示(右上)进行迭代精细化. 对于视频序列,这一过程在靠近序列中段(左下方)的具有代表性的键框上初始化,然后通过额外的键框(右下方)进行时间跟踪和完善.

blocks.en:
The GuidedSAM-Plume framework follows a standardized
interactive procedure designed to minimize user effort while
preserving expert control. The expert-guided workflow of the framework
is presented in Fig. 1 . The system supports both
individual images and image sequences: in the case of single images,
each frame requires user interaction, whereas for sequences, tracking
functionalities significantly reduce the level of manual input. The
guidance signal is provided in the form of spatial prompts, including
bounding boxes as well as positive points within the plume and negative points
in the surrounding background. These prompts can be combined to enable
flexible refinement. Refinement constitutes a central component of the
framework. Owing to the inherent complexity of volcanic plume imagery,
segmentation outputs may not fully capture the physically meaningful
plume extent. In such cases, the operator can iteratively refine the
segmentation by providing additional sparse annotations. The
segmentation mask is updated accordingly until it accurately
represents the observed plume geometry. For temporal sequences,
refinement can be further improved through interaction with additional
keyframes, thereby enhancing tracking performance. As presented later
in Section 5.3 , quantitative analyses indicate that
an effective strategy consists in initializing the interaction with a
bounding box enclosing the target plume, followed by incremental
refinement through the addition of point-based prompts to correct
observed errors. Regarding image time series or video data, it is
recommended to initialize the workflow on a representative frame
located near the middle of the sequence due to the high variability of plume structures
over time.

blocks.en: Workflow interface To support an efficient workflow in real-world applications, the GuidedSAM-Plume framework required to be released along with a dedicated operational interface.
blocks.zh: 工作流程接口 为了支持在现实世界应用中高效的工作流程,GuidedSAM-Plume框架需要与专用的操作界面一同发布.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Presentation of the GuidedSAM-Plume interface and its workflow. It includes keyframe prompting for sequences (A), mask propagation across frames (B), handling of individual images (C), and data export functionality (D).
blocks.zh: 图 2:介绍GuidedSAM-Plume接口及其工作流程. 它包括提示序列(A)的关键框架,遮罩跨帧传播(B),处理单个图像(C)和数据导出功能(D).

blocks.en: Built upon the open-source SAM2 Demo codebase [ 26 ] , it advances beyond existing SAM2 interfacing platforms [ 21 , 13 , 10 ] , offering a dedicated, fully functional interface specifically tailored for volcanic plume and cloud analysis. Its design is intentioned to support real-world usability. Notable added features include still image and sequence segmentation, multi-type prompt integration, segmentation export along with volcanology-specific metrics computation. An overview of the interface is shown in Figure 2 , and full technical details are provided in the open-source repository. This workflow interface completes the framework that effectively integrates expert knowledge into the interpretation of complex and ambiguous plume structures.
blocks.zh: 建于开源 SAM2 Demo Codebase [26],它超越了现有的SAM2接口平台[21,13,10],提供了一个专门,功能完备的界面,专门用于火山羽流和云分析. 它的设计旨在支持现实世界的可用性。 显著的新增特征包括静态图像和序列分解,多型即时集成,分解导出以及火山学特定度量衡计算. 界面概况见图2,开源寄存器中提供全部技术细节. 这种工作流程接口完成了将专家知识有效纳入复杂模糊的羽状结构解释的框架.

blocks.zh: 4 评价方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 议定书

blocks.en: SAM2 assessment
blocks.zh: SAM2评估

blocks.en: Effort was devoted to first validate a SAM2-based framework, and ensuring that it is reliable for the analysis of volcanic plume imagery. SAM2 inferences were performed using the largest variant version 2.1; the mask with highest confidence score was systematically selected among the three candidate outputs [ 26 ] . The proposed framework was benchmarked against available literature solution, namely the three architectures from [ 35 ] and VigiaPlume-Net [ 11 ] , with the latter evaluated on its eruption column class. Final masks produced through expert volcanologist guidance within the proposed framework were additionally evaluated.
blocks.zh: 努力首先验证一个基于SAM2-的框架,并确保它对于分析火山羽流图像是可靠的。 SAM2推论采用最大的变体2.1版本进行;信心分数最高的面罩被系统地选入三个候选产出[26]. 拟议框架以现有文献解决方案为基准,即[35]和VigiaPlume-Net[11]的三个架构,后者在其喷发专栏类别上进行了评估。 此外,还对拟议框架内通过火山专家指导制作的最后口罩进行了评价。

blocks.en: Further, realistic maximal expectations were estimated determining the minimal error owed to the intrinsic architecture. Segmentation models commonly produce output logits at a reduced resolution relative to the input; in SAM2, this downsampling factor is fourfold. They are subsequently upscaled to the original image resolution using bilinear interpolation and then thresholded to generate binary masks [ 26 ] . To quantify the associated loss in performance, the ground truths were successively downscaled to the input resolution ( 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 ), then to logits dimensions ( 256 × 256 256\times 256 ) before being upscaled to the original image dimensions, following the same resolution transformations as in the internal processing of SAM2.
blocks.zh: 此外,对内在结构的最小误差进行了估计,得出了现实的最大期望。 分解模型通常在相对输入的降低分辨率下产生输出对数;在SAM2中,这种下采样系数是四倍. 它们随后通过双线插图被提升到原始图像分辨率,然后被阈值生成二进制面具[26]. 为了量化相关的性能损失,地面真理被相继降级到输入分辨率(1024×1024 1024\times 1024),然后在升级到原始图像维度之前,进行与SAM2的内部处理相同的分辨率转换.

blocks.en: Workflow establishment
blocks.zh: 工作流程设置

blocks.en: Once the reliability of zero-shot capabilities from SAM2 were validated, different workflows were assessed to determine conditions leading to optimized prompting. Experiments were conducted for static images by observing the response of the model to different combination of bounding box and point-based input prompts. The rough mask prompting capability of SAM2 [ 26 ] was not considered, as it requires extensive annotation effort and is less suited for lightweight workflows. A maximum of five prompts per image were evaluated. The effects of randomly placed points and spatially predetermined points, such as the brightness point of the distance map, were compared. In random settings, metrics were averaged over 5 independent draws. Beyond static images, SAM2 supports the propagation of user-defined prompts across frames, enabling temporally consistent segmentation of video sequences from minimal initial input [ 26 ] . This capability was evaluated by supplying manually annotated masks as prompts on selected keyframes and assessing propagation quality on the remaining frames, thereby enabling both the evaluation of video propagation performance and the identification of an optimal keyframe prompting strategy. Additional analyses were performed to characterize the impact of using the framework on volcanological applications. These aspects are discussed further in Section 5.3 .
blocks.zh: 一旦SAM2的零射能力可靠性得到验证,就对不同的工作流程进行评估,以确定导致优化的提示条件. 通过观察模型对不同组合的边框和点基输入提示的反应,进行了静态图像实验. 没有考虑SAM2[26]的粗糙面罩激发能力,因为它需要广泛的注解努力,更不适合轻量级工作流程. 对每个图像最多5个提示进行了评价。 随机放置点和空间预定点,如距离图的亮度点的效果进行了比较. 在随机设置中,衡量标准平均超过5个独立绘图。 除了静态图像外,SAM2还支持跨帧传播用户定义的提示,使得视频序列在时间上能够从最小初始输入分解[26]. 通过提供手动附加说明的口罩作为选定关键框架的提示和评估剩余框架的传播质量,评估了这一能力,从而得以评价视频的传播性能并确定最佳关键框架的促进战略。 还进行了其他分析,以说明利用框架对火山应用的影响。 第5.3节将进一步讨论这些方面。

blocks.en: 4.3 Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.3 数据集

blocks.en: The dataset includes images of volcanic ash plumes and clouds acquired from ground-based camera systems during field campaigns and monitoring explosive eruptions. It consists of 47 manually segmented time-series sequences totaling 759 frames, with a mean sequence length of 16 frames and a mean spatial resolution of 2996 × 1685 2996\times 1685 pixels. The sequences span a wide range of conditions, including varying viewing angles, illumination, occlusions, and weather, as well as diverse plume dynamics from early formation (rising plume state) to fully developed structures (cloud dispersal state). Although modest in size, the dataset is representative of the data scarcity typically encountered in volcanological field conditions, with annotations carefully designed to capture the physically meaningful extent and morphological characteristics of the plumes. The dataset is made publicly available alongside a re-annotated version produced by volcanologist guidance within the GuidedSAM-Plume framework. Figure 3 presents a representative grid of samples from four video sequences included in the dataset.
blocks.zh: 数据集包括实地活动和监测爆炸爆发期间从地面摄像机系统获取的火山灰羽流和云的图像。 它由47个手动分割的时间序列组成,共759帧,平均序列长度为16帧,平均空间分辨率为2996×1685 2996\times 1685像素. 序列跨越了广泛的条件,包括不同的视角,闪光,隐蔽,和天气,以及从早期形成(形成羽状状态)到完全发展的结构(云散状态)的各种羽状动力学. 数据集虽然体积不大,但代表了火山场条件中通常遇到的数据稀缺,并精心设计了说明,以捕捉羽流的物理意义范围和形态特征. 该数据集连同由火山学家指导在《指南》框架内制作的重新说明版本一起公开提供。 图3显示数据集内四个视频序列样本的代表性网格.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Comparison with fully automatic methods
blocks.zh: 5.1 与全自动方法的比较

blocks.en: Quantitative analysis
blocks.zh: 定量分析

blocks.en: Table 1: Segmentation performance metrics (%) for volcanic plume segmentation, comparing Wilkes et al. [ 35 ] , VigiaPlume-Net [ 11 ] , and SAM2 [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 表1:火山羽流分解的分解性能指标(%),比较Wilkes等人. [35],维吉亚 Plume-Net [11],和SAM2 [26] (英语).

blocks.en: The GuidedSAM-Plume workflow was compared against existing dedicated fully automatic solutions for volcanic plume and cloud segmentation as well as a single-point SAM2 baseline. Following the protocol described in Section 4.1 , inference was performed for the models proposed by Wilkes et al. [ 35 ] and Giffard-Roisin et al. [ 11 ] , as well as for SAM2 [ 26 ] with a single randomly selected positive prompt (drawn from within the ground truth mask). Results are reported in Table 1 . While VigiaPlume-Net achieves the highest accuracy and precision, it underperforms notably on recall and volcanological metrics. Even without any refinement, SAM2 considerably outperforms existing solutions, demonstrating the value of exploiting its zero-shot capabilities for volcanic plume segmentation. An overall lower performance is observed on the boundary-sensitive F measure across all methods, though SAM2 also achieves higher scores on this metric and results further show that it can be improved on a case-by-case basis. In this regard, final results obtained with the full expert-guided GuidedSAM-Plume framework are also reported, showing considerable additional improvements over the fully automated methods and confirming that targeted expert refinement further enhances segmentation performance of SAM2. The observed performance gains substantiate that the additional annotation effort required by the framework is well justified, supporting its adoption for quantitative volcanological studies.
blocks.zh: 将GuidedSAM-Plume工作流程与现有的火山羽流和云分化全自动专用解决方案以及单点SAM2基线进行比较。 按照第4.1节所述协议,对Wilkes等人提议的模型进行了推断。 [35] and Giffard-Roisin et al. [11],以及SAM2 [26] 单随机选择的正时速(从地面真相面具内抽取). 成果见表1。 虽然VigiaPlume-Net的准确度和精确度最高,但它在召回和火山测量方面表现不佳。 即使没有任何改进,SAM2也大大超过现有的解决方案,显示出利用其零射能力进行火山羽流分解的价值. 在所有方法的边界敏感F度量上观察到总体性能较低,虽然SAM2在这一度量上也取得了较高的分数,结果进一步表明可以根据具体情况加以改进. 在这方面,还报告了采用完整的专家指导的SAM-Plume框架所取得的最后结果,表明比完全自动化的方法有了相当大的改进,并证实有针对性的专家改进进一步提高了SAM2的分化性能。 所观察到的业绩成果证实,框架要求的额外注解工作是完全合理的,支持采用该框架进行定量火山研究。

blocks.en: Qualitative analysis of challenging scenes
blocks.zh: 对具有挑战性的场景进行定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 4: Qualitative comparison of segmentation outputs across models on the most challenging scenes of the dataset. Ground-truth annotations are shown in blue and outputs in red.
blocks.zh: 图4:在数据集最具挑战性的场景上对各模型的分割输出进行定性比较. 地面真实说明以蓝色显示,产出以红色显示。

blocks.en:
Visual inspection of segmentations, particularly in the most challenging scenes, is necessary to better interpret the relative effectiveness of the compared models and the significance of observed metric discrepancies. Figure 4 presents the scenes yielding the worst segmentation results under the GuidedSAM-Plume framework. In these cases, degraded performance is primarily attributable to highly diffuse boundaries, heterogeneous opacity, small plume extents amplifying relative errors, or out-of-focus imagery. It is worth noting that under such conditions, plume delineation may vary between human annotators and therefore does not necessarily reflect a strict segmentation error. Given the acceptable produced segmentation even in these conditions, a further advantage of the proposed framework lies in its ability to standardize ambiguous delineation decisions and reduce inter-annotator variability.
For the same scenes, the models of Wilkes et al. exhibit a tendency to generate spurious plume detections on background regions. VigiaPlume-Net systematically produces staircase boundary artifacts that fail to preserve plume geometric characteristics, limiting its suitability for downstream quantitative analysis.
blocks.zh:
对分块,特别是在最具挑战性的场景中的分块进行目视检查,对于更好地解释比较模型的相对效力和观察到的度量差异的意义是必要的。 图4介绍了在《指南》SAM-Plume框架下产生最差分解结果的场景。 在这些情况下,退化的性能主要归因于边界高度分散、不透明、羽流范围小、相对误差扩大或重点不突出的图像。 值得注意的是,在此种条件下,人际注释者之间的羽流划分可能有所不同,因此不一定反映严格的分化错误。 鉴于即使在这些条件下也会产生可以接受的分割,拟议框架的另一个优点在于它能够使模棱两可的划界决定标准化,并减少通知人之间的可变性。
对于同一场景,威尔克斯等人的模型显示出在背景区域产生虚假羽流探测的倾向. 维吉亚 Plume-Net系统生产无法保存羽状几何特征的阶梯边界文物,限制了其适合下游定量分析.

blocks.en: 5.2 Maximal expected performance
blocks.zh: 5.2 最大预期业绩

blocks.en: Table 2: Best achievable performance and minimal error for morphological descriptors (%). Poor performances are highlighted in bold.
blocks.zh: 表2:形态描述器的最佳可实现性能和最小误差(%)。 成绩不佳用黑体突出。

blocks.en: To better quantify the intrinsic limitations of the proposed framework, downscaling and reupscaling manipulations where performed on ground truths as described in Section 4.1 . The resulting performance over the metrics between the original ground truth and the downscaled then re-upscaled ones are reported in Table 2 . The most critical errors to consider are those affecting the volcanological descriptors, as these directly reflect the impact on downstream analyses. To better characterize degradation trends, both absolute and signed relative errors with respect to the ground truth are reported for the underlying morphological descriptors from which these metrics are derived. For most metrics, the loss is negligible but large discrepancies are observed in metrics that rely on edge measurements, i.e. F F , J & F J\&F and 𝐶𝑉𝑋 ​ ϵ \mathit{CVX}{\epsilon} . This is expected, as boundaries are highly sensitive to scaling processes. The contour perimeter, convex hull perimeter and area exhibit identical mean relative and absolute errors, indicating a unidirectional and consistently negative bias. Notably, the magnitude of the perimeter bias is consistent with loss on convexity exceeding 6%, while errors in solidity are primarily driven by a slight underestimation of the convex hull area. These observations reveal an unavoidable smoothing effect intrinsic to the SAM2 architecture. Thus established lower bound on performance provides a reference baseline for the evaluation of empirical results.
blocks.zh: 如第4.1节所述,为了更好地量化拟议框架的内在局限性,缩小和重新扩大对实地真相的操纵。 表2汇报了在原始地面真相与被缩小的然后被重新扩大的尺度之间的衡量尺度上的绩效。 最关键的差错是影响火山特征的差错,因为这些差错直接反映了对下游分析的影响。 为了更好地描述退化趋势,报告这些指标所依据的基本形态描述值的地面真实性绝对错误和签名相对错误。 对于大多数的度量衡,损失是可忽略不计的,但在依赖于边缘测量的度量中观察到了巨大的差异,即F F,J & F J\&F和CVX ε\ mathit{CVX}{\ X}{\epsilon}. 由于边界对规模化进程高度敏感,预计会出现这种情况。 轮廓、对流船体周界和地区均显示出相同的相对和绝对错误,表明存在单向和一贯的负面偏差。 值得注意的是,周边偏差的幅度与对流损失超过6%一致,而固态误差主要是对对对流船体面积略微低估所致。 这些观察揭示了SAM2架构所固有的不可避免的平滑效应. 因此,对业绩的既定较低约束为评价实证成果提供了参考基线。

blocks.en: 5.3 Workflow establishment
blocks.zh: 5.3 建立工作流程

blocks.en: Prompts efficiency
blocks.zh: 提高效率

blocks.en: Table 3: Comparison of segmentation results across different prompt configurations, combining foreground points (FP), background points (BP), and bounding boxes (BB). When applicable, the center corresponds to the brightest point in the distance map.
blocks.zh: 表3:不同即时配置的分解结果比较,结合了前景点(FP),背景点(BP)和边框(BB). 适用时,中心对应距离图中最亮的点.

blocks.en:
Representative results of SAM2 across various prompt combinations are
reported in Table 3 . When using a single prompt, a
bounding box consistently outperforms a single positive point. Note that negative points are not meaningful in this single prompt setting. No
significant performance difference was observed between a randomly
selected point and one located at the center of the distance
map. These findings align with observations reported in the original
SAM study [ 17 ] and underscore the value of an
expert-guided strategy, where prompts are informed by domain knowledge
rather than predetermined spatial patterns. When no bounding box is
included, overall segmentation performance declines markedly, even
when four to five point prompts are provided, while precision remains
relatively stable. This suggests that the segmentation workflow should
be designed such that operators initiate the process with a bounding
box, which provides a strong spatial prior. Furthermore, as shown in the lower section of Table 3 , supplementing the bounding box with randomly placed points yields no significant improvement; the best results are consistently obtained with a
bounding box complemented by a small number of selectively placed
points, with a preference for background points. Unnecessary or
excessive point prompts may in fact be counterproductive. Point
prompts should therefore be incorporated iteratively and selectively,
targeting regions where refinement is genuinely needed rather than
maximizing the number of prompts. These results emphasize that an
expert-guided approach, initialized with a bounding box and
complemented by selective point prompts, provides the most efficient
and reliable strategy for SAM2-based segmentation of complex natural
structures.

blocks.en: Video propagation assessment
blocks.zh: 视频传播评估

blocks.en: Table 4: Video propagation performance depending on the position of the prompted frame in the sequence (%). First refers to the first frame that is not purely background in the sequence.
blocks.zh: 表4:视频传播性能,取决于所提示的框架在序列中的位置(%)。 第一是指序列中并非纯背景的第一帧.

blocks.en: We assessed the quality of mask propagation depending on the annotated keyframes. In Table 4 , we present the results of the different propagation performances as a function of the position of the prompted frame, averaging the results over the remaining frames in the sequence. Propagation was initialized from ground-truth masks as input, reflecting an interactive setting in which an expert can readily refine the input mask prior to propagation. Results indicate that propagation performance remains relatively stable across video sequences. Notably, the boundary F-score exceeds those previously observed for static image segmentation, suggesting that temporal propagation does not degrade contour accuracy compared to what can be achieved on a single frame. Initializing propagation from the beginning or end of the sequence yields comparable trends, though performance is lower when starting from the first frame, likely due to the limited spatial extent of the plume in early sequence stages. A slight advantage is observed when initializing from a middle frame, where the plume is already sufficiently developed and fewer frames are subject to error propagation. Last line in the Table 4 show that performance is further improved when propagation is initialized from the middle frame and subsequent keyframes are added. Overall, SAM2 video propagation proves reliable and well-suited to real-world conditions. For practical use, initializing propagation from a middle frame is recommended, with targeted expert refinement applied as needed.
blocks.zh: 我们根据附加说明的关键框架评估了口罩传播的质量。 在表4中,我们列出不同传播性能的结果,作为提示框位置的函数,平均显示序列中其余帧的结果。 从地面真实口罩初始化为输入,反映了一种互动环境,在这种环境中,专家可以在传播前随时改进输入口罩。 结果表明,各种视频系列的传播性能仍然相对稳定。 值得注意的是,边界F-分数超过了以前观测到的静态图像分解,这表明时间传播不会比在单一框架上实现的精度降低。 从序列的起始或结尾开始初始传播会产生类似的趋势,尽管从第一个帧开始时性能较低,这可能是由于羽流在早期阶段的空间范围有限。 在从中间框架初始化时,可以看到一个微小的优势,即羽流已经足够发达,而且较少的帧受到错误传播的影响。 表4最后一行显示,在从中间框架初始传播并添加随后的关键框架时,性能得到进一步改善。 总体而言,SAM2视频的传播证明是可靠的,非常适合现实世界的条件。 为实用起见,建议从中间框架初始化传播,并根据需要对专家进行有针对性的改进。

blocks.en: Impact on volcanological applications
blocks.zh: 对火山学应用的影响

blocks.en:
We investigated the impact of masks produced by the GuidedSAM-Plume framework on downstream volcanological
analyses. As previously reported in Table 1 , all
metrics derived from volcanological parameters exceed 90% with the
complete workflow, indicating reliable performance. To further
characterize this agreement, we examine two geometric
descriptors: plume perimeter and area. Their deviations to manually
produced reference masks, as a function of these quantities, are
presented in Figure 5 . A
predominantly negative deviation is observed for perimeter of masks
produced with the framework, reflecting a boundary smoothing effect
that becomes more pronounced and dispersed with increasing plume size.
A similar trend being observed for area, the boundary smoothing effect
is predominantly concave; in other words, mask boundaries mostly
manifest an inward contraction. These tendencies warrant careful
consideration when exploiting GuidedSAM-Plume outputs for
downstream quantitative analyses. Nevertheless, the observed
deviations remain proportionally small, particularly for area
estimates which are less sensitive to contour errors. Moreover, such
deviations are arguably better controlled through a standardized
framework than the inter-annotator variability inherent to purely
manual annotation.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and conclusion
blocks.zh: 讨论和结论

blocks.en: GuidedSAM-Plume introduces a validated interactive segmentation framework for volcanic plume and cloud analysis, combining automated processing with expert-guided refinement of ambiguous regions. It offers a balance between expert intervention and processing efficiency compared to existing workflows, while maintaining strong agreement with ground-truth segmentation and preserving the reliability of derived volcanological measurements. In practice, expert annotation time was reduced from approximately 2 hours to 5–10 minutes per 10-frame sequence, varying with image resolution and scene complexity 1 1 1 Improvements observed on a workstation equipped with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (16 GB vRAM) GPU. . Moreover, deviations observed with manual masks in morphometric parameters that directly influence volcanological analyses remain controlled and predominantly systematic in direction, which strengthens the overall reliability. Correcting for these systematic biases in downstream analyses represents a promising direction to further improve the accuracy of derived volcanological measurements. Further validation on second-order parameters, including real-scale plume dimensions and dynamic properties, would be valuable to more comprehensively confirm the robustness of the framework for operational applications.
blocks.zh: GuidedSAM-Plume引入了经验证的火山羽流和云分析交互分块框架,将自动处理与专家指导的模糊区域完善相结合. 与现有工作流程相比,它提供了专家干预和处理效率之间的平衡,同时对地面-真实划分保持强烈的一致,并维护衍生火山测量的可靠性。 在实践中,专家注释时间从每10帧序列约2小时减少到5-10分钟,与图像分辨率和场景复杂性不同 1 1 1 在一个配备了NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080(16 GB vRAM) GPU的工作站上观察到改进. 此外,人工遮罩观察到的直接影响火山分析的扰动参数的偏差仍然得到控制,并主要有系统地朝向,从而加强了整体可靠性。 纠正下游分析中的这些系统性偏差,是进一步提高火山测量准确性的一个有希望的方向。 进一步验证二阶参数,包括实际规模的羽流尺寸和动态特性,对于更全面地确认业务应用框架的稳健性具有价值。

blocks.en: It should be noted that the present contribution is subject to several limitations. Refinement capabilities are inherently bounded by the design of SAM models, which were trained on a limited number of input points or short video sequences [ 17 , 26 ] . Moreover, although it improves upon fully automatic methods, it cannot dispense with expert intervention. The modest dataset size narrows the scope of quantitative evaluation, notably the relatively short size of temporal sequences. These limitations reflect the typical constraints inherent to volcanological studies. Nevertheless, wider adoption of the framework has the potential to facilitate the expansion of available data in this domain. In order to address the broader needs of the volcanological community, future development should integrate real-scale physical metric conversion, and incorporating multi-scale processing capabilities spanning from plume-level to particle-level characterization within a unified workflow.
blocks.zh: 应当指出,目前的贡献受到若干限制。 完善能力在本质上是由SAM模型的设计所限定的,这些模型在有限的输入点或短视频序列上接受了训练[17,26]. 此外,虽然它改进了完全自动的方法,但不能不采用专家干预。 有限的数据集大小缩小了定量评价的范围,特别是时间序列的相对短小. 这些局限性反映了火山学研究所固有的典型制约. 然而,更广泛地采用该框架有可能促进扩大这一领域的现有数据。 为了满足火山界更广泛的需要,未来的发展应结合实际规模的物理度量衡转换,并将从羽流级到颗粒级定性的多尺度处理能力纳入统一的工作流程.

blocks.en: Overall, the results highlight the potential of zero-shot foundation models to improve the reproducibility and efficiency of segmentation-based analysis for volcanology despite limited data availability. The absence of requirements for heavy domain-specific retraining is expected to encourage adoption within the volcanological community. The proposed framework has already been effectively deployed under real-world settings by volcanologists to produce the standardized re-annotated version of the released dataset. Both the open-source interface and the novelly annotated dataset are intended to foster broader contributions and future works. The demonstrated stable performance across diverse plume morphologies and challenging imaging conditions, suggests strong generalization potential beyond volcanology. Applicability may extend to plume-shaped phenomena across a wide range of environmental contexts, including aeolian dust remobilization, atmospheric clouds, wildfire smoke, but also anthropogenic plumes such as smokestack emissions and industrial fires.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果突出表明,尽管数据有限,但零射线基础模型有可能提高火山学分解分析的可复制性和效率。 缺乏针对特定领域重度再培训的要求,预计会鼓励火山学界的收养。 火山学家已经在现实世界环境中有效部署了拟议框架,以制作发布的数据集的标准化重新说明版。 开源界面和新注解的数据集都是为了促进更广泛的贡献和未来的工作。 不同羽状形态和具有挑战性的成像条件的显示性能稳定,表明火山学以外的强通化潜力。 适用于各种环境环境中的羽毛状现象,包括海鸟尘埃再起、大气云、野火烟,以及烟雾排放和工业火灾等人为羽毛。
